title: Language Server Protocol
claims: LSP defines JSON-RPC messages between development tools and language servers
latest specification is 3.18
notes: Live protocol, not a durable repository-index guarantee.

title: Introduction
claims: incremental parser builds concrete syntax trees
aims to remain useful with syntax errors
notes: Parser edits must be synchronized with source edits.

title: ast-grep
claims: structural search/rewrite is Tree-sitter based
Node API exposes syntax trees
notes: Syntax matching is not semantic binding.

title: LSIF Specification
claims: LSIF serializes workspace knowledge
mutating-document requests are typically excluded because changes invalidate data
notes: Current spec is marked under construction.

title: SCIP protocol
claims: an index is rooted at one workspace directory
occurrences associate source positions with symbols
notes: Workspace identity should be part of every lookup.

title: ripgrep User Guide
claims: search observes ignore files and filters hidden/binary files by default
--files exposes selected file inventory
notes: Ignore policy is part of retrieval provenance.

title: ctags JSON output
claims: JSON Lines output includes tag name/path/language/kind and optional scope
notes: Tags are not compiler-level references.

title: GraphRAG indexing
claims: pipeline extracts entities/relations/claims, communities and summaries
outputs structured tables and embeddings
notes: Indexing cost and freshness need evaluation.

title: HippoRAG 2: From RAG to Memory
claims: repository identifies HippoRAG 2 as a memory framework
repository links HippoRAG and follow-up papers
notes: Published benchmark claims are not local harness measurements.

title: LightRAG
claims: canonical project distinguishes naive text-chunk RAG from knowledge-graph retrieval
documents processing and reproduction material
notes: Corrected from a fork; deletion guarantees were not established in this pass.

title: Graphiti
claims: official repository identifies Graphiti as real-time knowledge graphs for AI agents
notes: Temporal and tenant guarantees require a dedicated review.

title: Using a Property Graph Index
claims: framework documents a property graph index module
notes: Framework abstraction is not compiler-authoritative semantics.

title: Open Source Overview
claims: self-hosted engine allows configurable LLM/embedder/vector/history/reranker
documents library and server forms
notes: Component configuration does not itself establish isolation.

title: Memory blocks
claims: memory blocks persist in context across interactions
blocks are always injected rather than retrieved
notes: Use for small explicit policy, not unbounded history.

title: claude-mem repository
claims: captures tool observations, compresses summaries and injects future context
documents local settings
notes: Memory data needs ownership, provenance and deletion tests.

title: RAPTOR official implementation
claims: official implementation identifies recursive clustering/summarization hierarchy
retrieval can operate at multiple granularities
notes: Corrected from a different later implementation; derived summaries require reverse invalidation.

title: RepoCoder
claims: paper proposes iterative retrieval-generation for repository code completion
introduces RepoEval
notes: Research result is not local agent evidence.

title: Repoformer
claims: paper proposes selective repository retrieval rather than retrieval for every request
notes: Gate use by local evaluation.

title: Joern
claims: repository identifies an open-source code analysis platform based on code property graphs
notes: Adjacent candidate only.

title: Filtering
claims: documentation exposes filtering, hybrid/sparse search, multitenancy and indexing topics
notes: Prove scope filtering and deletion behavior before adoption.

title: DidCloseTextDocument Notification
claims: Closing changes document-content ownership; server request fulfillment is independent of whether the document is open or closed.
notes: Official specification fragment fetched after the rendered specification exposed navigation only. The Splyce requirement for server-specific retained-copy purge is a design consequence, not an erasure guarantee supplied by didClose. No server run.
